explanation: OEIS A001818 (a(n) = ((2n−1)!!)²), Z.-W. Sun's Conjecture 1 (proved by She–Sun–Xia): for any primitive 2n-th root of unity ζ, the permanent of [m(j,k)] (2n×2n), with m(j,k) = (1 + ζ^(j−k))/(1 − ζ^(j−k)) for j ≠ k and 1 on the diagonal, equals ((2n−1)!!)². The formal matrix uses 0-based indices, which is harmless since only j − k matters, and integer powers of ζ; a(n) is the squared product of odd numbers. Faithful.
